about: The 1.8.9 movement oracle's FLAT world: a stone floor whose top face is y = 64 over chunk columns -2..2 (x and z in [-32, 47]), a 3-deep still-water pool (x, z in [-24, -14]), a floorless pit (x 28..40, z -30..-18), a 3-high wall at x = 24 (z 0..16), a pillar at (0, -20) with a south-facing ladder on its south face, and a low ceiling (2 blocks of headroom) over x -12..-4, z 4..20.
